explication: Locus is an on-device iPhone location-spoofing app. The user completes pairing and tunnel setup, selects a location or route on the map, then starts teleporting, joystick movement, or route playback; SpoofSession coordinates simulation and persistence while LocationEngine injects coordinates through the developer-location tunnel. The graph also preserves pairing, GPX, saved places, background status, and setup capabilities documented in the README. Some feature implementation is unsampled, so uncertain wiring is omitted.
